description_en: Removes an EIP from an Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
description_zh: 调用RemoveGlobalAccelerationInstanceIp接口从带宽共享实例中移除EIP
kebab_example: aliyun vpc remove-global-acceleration-instance-ip --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --global-acceleration-instance-id ga-m5ex47zwya1sejyni0000 --ip-instance-id eip-bp13e9i2qst4g6jzi0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveGlobalAccelerationInstanceIp

parameters.help_en: The region where the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance is located. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 带宽共享型实例所在的地域。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
parameters.name: global_acceleration_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the EIP instance.

parameters.help_zh:
